description: Aikido is a Japanese martial art focused on self-defense, while minimizing injury to the attacker.  It uses defensive throws and disarms but its techniques lack offensive power.
initiate: You enter the hanmi stance.
%s enters a relaxed combat posture.

static_buffs.name: Aikido Stance
static_buffs.description:
By disregarding offense in favor of defense, you are better at protecting yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity, +2 blocking effectiveness, +1.0 Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Intermediate Aikido
static_buffs.description:
An intermediate Aikido practitioner can protect themselves against multiple opponents.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity, +1 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt.

static_buffs.name: Advanced Aikido
static_buffs.description:
An advanced Aikido practitioner can protect themselves against even more opponents than normal.

+1 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt.

onblock_buffs.name: Fluid Blocking
onblock_buffs.description:
After a smooth block, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

ondodge_buffs.name: Fluid Dodging
ondodge_buffs.description:
After a smooth dodge, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

name: Eskrima
description: Eskrima, also known as Kali, is a Filipino martial art.  It emphasizes rapid strikes with knife and baton weapons, along with a variety of improvised substitutes.
initiate: You enter an open guard stance and prepare to strike.
%s enters an open stance.

static_buffs.name: Eskrima Stance
static_buffs.description:
You are skilled at getting the most out of your weapons.  The term 'weapon' might be very subjective.

+2 accuracy.

oncrit_buffs.name: Eskrima Combination
oncrit_buffs.description:
You can follow up a critical hit with a stronger attack if the opportunity presents itself.

+15% damage.
Enables "Combination Strike" technique.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

name: Fencing
description: The noble art of fencing is taught with flexible competition blades, but the techniques are derived from (and applicable to) more functional examples.  Skilled fencers can take advantage of blocks and feints to deliver accurate strikes.
initiate: You move into the en-garde stance.
%s moves into a fencing stance.

static_buffs.name: Fencing Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your side stance reduces the chance that you will be harmed in combat.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Dexterity.

onblock_buffs.name: Parry
onblock_buffs.description:
Your next strike will find its mark much easier after your parry.

+1 accuracy.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmiss_buffs.name: Remise
onmiss_buffs.description:
Your feint is the perfect setup for a devastating followup attack!

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Counter Time
onpause_buffs.description:
You fake an attack and prepare yourself to unleash a Compound Attack.

+2 blocking effectiveness.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.

name: Fior Di Battaglia
description: Medieval Europe's martial techniques for fighting with hooked weapons.  The "Flower of Battle" places great focus on countering one's opponent and knocking them down before landing a killing blow.
initiate: You hold your weapon in a firm grip, ready to block any attack.
%s grips their weapon tightly.

static_buffs.name: Stand Your Ground
static_buffs.description:
You are stalwart and will not budge against any threat.

+2 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, -1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Tactical Retreat
onmove_buffs.description:
You moved and nullified the effects of Stand Your Ground!

-2 blocking effectiveness, -1 block attempt, +1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage increased by 50% of Strength.
Prevents "High Round Strike" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.

onmiss_buffs.name: Tactical Feinting
onmiss_buffs.description:
They fell for your feint!

Enables "Hook and Drag" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onblock_buffs.name: Defense Break
onblock_buffs.description:
Each successful block reveals an opening in your opponent's guard.

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Displace and Hook" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

name: Judo
description: Judo is a martial art that focuses on grabs and throws, both defensive and offensive.  You are resistant to most effects that can knock you down and can counter grab and takedown attacks with a strong judo throw.
initiate: You prepare yourself for a grapple.
%s prepares for a grapple.

static_buffs.name: Judo Stance
static_buffs.description: Your knowledge of grappling allows you to recover from knockdown effects instantly.  In addition, you can counter grabs and takedown attacks with a judo throw.

ondodge_buffs.name: Perfect Position
ondodge_buffs.description:
You've moved into a perfect position to counter attack!

+30% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

name: Krav Maga
description: Originating in Israel, Krav Maga is based on taking down an enemy quickly and effectively.  It focuses on applicable attacks rather than showy or complex moves.  Popular among police and armed forces everywhere.
initiate: You assume a practical combat stance.
%s assumes a practical combat stance.

static_buffs.name: Krav Maga Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training makes it easier to land hits and fight multiple opponents.

+1 accuracy, +1 block attempt.

onblock_buffs.name: Strike Vitals
onblock_buffs.description:
Like a fool, your opponent has left themselves wide open.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.

name: Medieval Swordsmanship
description: The art of the longsword and sword & buckler, preceding the later development of fencing.  Designed for combat both unarmored and in armor, it includes grappling as well as defensive and offensive sword techniques.  This style is a combination of the Italian and German traditions.
initiate: You take on a knightly stance.
%s takes on a knightly stance.

static_buffs.name: Swordsman's Stance
static_buffs.description:
Through chivalry and vigilance, your defense with a blade has increased.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Mastercut
onblock_buffs.description:
You parry and return the attack with greater vigor!

+10% damage, -10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

onhit_buffs.name: Conserve Momentum
onhit_buffs.description:
You maintain the momentum from your last strike to move more quickly.

-20% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Half Swording
onpause_buffs.description:
You grip the blade partway down for greater control.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -1 accuracy.
Enables "Grab" and "Lethal Strike" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.

name: Ninjutsu
description: Ninjutsu is a martial art and set of tactics used by ninja in feudal Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise, silent strikes.  Ninjutsu is almost entirely silent and you have a higher chance to critically hit on your first attack.  It also provides small combat bonuses every time you move.
initiate: You perform a kuji-in mantra with your hands.  Rin, Kai, Jin!
%s performs a series of intricate hand signs.

static_buffs.name: Ninjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training allows you to make no noise when attacking and less noise when moving around.

Melee and unarmed attacks generate 0 noise, moving generates 1/2 as much noise.

static_buffs.name: Sneak Attack
static_buffs.description:
To a true shinobi, the first strike and the last strike are one and the same.

+25% critical hit chance.

onattack_buffs.name: Loss of Surprise
onattack_buffs.description:
Your intentions are known!  It will take you a few moments to sneak attack again.

Disables "Sneak Attack" buff and "Assassinate" and "Ninjutsu Takedown" techniques.  Enables "Swift Strike (crit)" technique.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

onmove_buffs.name: Momentum Shift
onmove_buffs.description:
Ninja are trained to be extremely agile and mobile.

+1.0 Dodging skill, accuracy increased by 20% of Dexterity.
Lasts 1 turn.

onkill_buffs.name: Escape Plan
onkill_buffs.description:
Your target has perished.  It is time to leave and plan your next attack.

+2 dodge attempts, +10 movement speed.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

name: Niten Ichi-Ryu
description: Niten Ichi-Ryu is an ancient school of combat, transmitting a style of classical Japanese swordsmanship conceived by the warrior Miyamoto Musashi.  Perception increases damage and reduces blocked damage.  Moving and attacking reduces dodging and damage until you pause.  Pausing for a moment increases Dodging skill.
initiate: You clear your mind as you prepare yourself for combat.
%s relaxes and prepares for combat.

static_buffs.name: Niten Ichi-Ryu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Cautious watchful eyes,
measure and display your skill.
Practice makes perfect.

Armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Perception.

onmove_buffs.name: Waning Moon
onmove_buffs.description:
Blackened like darkness,
nightmares approach from all sides.
Flee at any cost!

-5.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.

onattack_buffs.name: Falling Leaf
onattack_buffs.description:
A sharp sword cuts true.
Although, all things fade with time.
Restraint hones your skills.

-1.0 Dodging skill, -5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 5 times.

ondodge_buffs.name: Moonlight
ondodge_buffs.description:
Luck be the light,
on a dark and cloudy night,
as the moon shines down.

Enables "In-One Timing" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Stillness
onpause_buffs.description:
The eye of the storm,
a fleeting moment of peace,
gone without a trace.

+2 accuracy, Dodging skill increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.

name: Silat
description: Pencak Silat, of Indonesian origin, is a fighting style that covers the use of short blades and bludgeons.  Fighters stay low and mobile to avoid attacks, then unleash deadly critical hits.
initiate: You give a salute of respect as you prepare for combat.
%s gives a combat salute.

static_buffs.name: Silat Stance
static_buffs.description:
You try to stay as loose as possible when fighting to have more chances to dodge.

+1 dodge attempt.

ondodge_buffs.name: Silat Appraisal
ondodge_buffs.description:
Each time you dodge an attack, you learn a bit more about your opponent's fighting style.  This allows you to make more precise attacks against them.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Dexterity.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Silat Ambush
onmove_buffs.description:
You stay low as you move, making it harder for enemies to defend against you.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.

name: Sojutsu
description: Sōjutsu, "The Way of the Spear", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a spear.  Sōjutsu focuses on keeping opponents at a distance in order to maintain the advantage in combat.  Standing still gives you an extra block attempt but moving will briefly increase your damage.
initiate: You prepare to defend against all that approach you.
%s assumes a wide, defensive stance.

static_buffs.name: Sōjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training grants better defense while using a polearm.

+1 block attempt, +2 blocking effectiveness.

onmove_buffs.name: Superior Positioning
onmove_buffs.description:
You have given up your defenses for a moment to increase the damage of your attacks.

+10% damage, -1 block attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.
